title: The spam update that would not end
body: For anyone whose traffic dipped since 24 September.

title: Still rolling since 24 September
body: Google's Search Status Dashboard still says ongoing.

title: The other three took under 3 days
body: March: 19 hours. June: 2 days. August: under 3 days.

title: When did your drop start?
body: Before 24 September? It was not this update.

title: Set Search Console to 16 months
body: Compare with the same weeks last year before you blame Google.

title: Position down, or only clicks?
body: Position steady and CTR down means the results page changed, not your rank.

title: Wait for the end date before judging
body: Changes made mid rollout cannot be measured yet.
